post.text:
In 2017, Seven‑year‑old Matilda Jones was paddling in Dozmary Pool in Cornwall when she spotted something lying flat on the bottom. It was a four‑foot sword. According to legend, this is the very lake where King Arthur’s Excalibur was thrown before he died.

Matilda’s father, https://t.co/ultYqiC5wj
post.author_description: Researcher and Author, with profound interest in ancient history. Holds the doctorate (PhD.) degree in History and specialisation in Archaeology. (999)

description.description: A man and a young girl are standing in knee-deep water in a lake. The man is holding a long, rusted sword vertically in the air, while the girl beside him cheers with her arms raised, holding a green fishing net. In the bottom left corner, an inset photograph shows the same young girl standing in a field, holding the large, rusted sword upright with both hands.
